name: Ranked
description: The competitive ruleset: everything in Gecko Codes/Ranked, on by default. Add a code to that folder and it lands in this download.
_notes: Manual Fielder Select.c is the only code here that hooks 0x80678F8C: the v4.1 and
v5.0 .asm files and the half-finished C port that all shared that site were
folded into it (v5 behaviour). Keep it that way -- cgecko keys codes by name, so
two files hooking one site build fine and silently fight at runtime.
